items.html: And when Aba and Ima were corrected, the judgments (Dinim) descended below, into ZON. And when ZON were corrected, the Emanator, blessed be He, saw that if they were corrected in the aspect of face to face, the Klipot and the judgments would attach themselves to their posteriors (Achoraim) — since they are judgments, and especially since they are below. Therefore He corrected them back to back, and through this they could not attach themselves there. For to guard that they should not attach themselves to the face, this is certainly unnecessary, since they have no hold there at all.
